results.title: Picasso, Miró and Dalí’s original prints go on show at CMYK Bookstore in Delhi
results.content: What happens when three of modern art’s most recognizable names are taken off the canvas? At CMYK Bookstore in Delhi, more than 60 original lithographs and etchings offer a closer look at Picasso, Miró and Dalí

results.title: Supreme Court agrees to hear challenge to definition of ‘industry’ in new Central law
results.content: The All India Trade Union Congress Tamil Nadu’s petition challenged the definition of ‘industry’ under the Industrial Relations Code (IRC) 2020 as “deliciously vague”; The senior counsel Gopal Sankaranarayanan said the definition in the IRC Code did not meet the requirements of the ‘triple test’

results.title: Mudalur, Tamil Nadu’s first Christian settlement, stands tall with its magnificent church tower
results.content: Established in 1799, Mudalur was the first exclusive settlement created for newly converted Christians in Tamil Nadu. Some claim it was the first Christian village in India and Asia.

results.title: Can Indian homegrown smartphone brands compete with global giants?
results.content: The government’s goal of establishing a homegrown smartphone brand by October 2028 sets a clear benchmark for national ambition. However, achieving market relevance against global leaders requires moving past price competition and contract assembly
